newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end lower after late sell-off.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end lower after late sell-off.

text.p: Oct 10 - U.S. debt futures ended lower after a heavy sell-off. Volume picked up as Dec T-bonds punctured 110-05/32 and 110-00. Forecasts for a rise of 1.3 pct in Sept retail sales, and underlying concerns about Sept producer, consumer prices, nagged the market. Market lacked buyers all day, but still some long positions intact in both bonds and Euros. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
